profile.headline: Software Engineer

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Develop and maintain internal tooling to help workers maintain and expand customer base
• Work on integrations with Salesforce, ContentStack, Zoom, Youtube, and Smartsheets
• Develop cloud based solutions on AWS, including EC2, Lambda, and API Gateway amongst others
• Develop and maintain end-to-end testing frameworks using Selenium, PhpUnit, pytest, locust (for load testing) and Postman
• Experience with PHP, Javascript/Typescript, Python, Java, and Python

company.name: The Escal Institute Of Advanced Technologies, Inc.

positions.title: Software Engineer in Test
positions.description:
• Develop and maintain automated testing software using selenium based framework, Serenity written in Java, as well as legacy
testing framework Geb written in Groovy
• Lead training programs and onboarding for new automation testers.
• Responsible for creation and execution of of manual testing strategies pre-release
• Developed testing strategies to test transition from manual deployments to automated deployments
positions.insights: Test Engineering, Test Automation and +2 skills

positions.title: Teacher Assistant
positions.description:
• Assisted students in Calculus, Computer Science, and Economics courses
• Developed training programs for students with special needs
• Assisted professors in identifying incoming student weaknesses

positions.title: IT Technician
positions.description:
• Develop ISO 27001 compliance document for organization
• Develop standards for digitization of physical legal documents via OCR technologies, as well as standards for digitization of new
legal documents
• Train office workers on new ICT processes
• Assist ICT manager on setting up workplaces
positions.insights: Information Technology Infrastructure, Technical Support and +2 skills

educations.fieldOfStudy: Economics w/minor Mathematics and Computer Science
